name: SDN GP Archive Records
description: Builds the GP history archive's $MPE element sets and $CAT catalog rows in archive encoding v1: the exact byte layout the archive's content IDs (sha256 over the record bytes) depend on. Records are built with the schema-generated SDS C++ builders; field names and vtable slots come only from the generated headers, and the field order and default handling are a compatibility contract gated by fixture bytes from the importer's original builder. Pure compute; output bytes depend only on input bytes.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each record is encoded independently in one bounded pass; the module starts no workers. Hosts parallelize by invoking separate instances on separate batches.

acceptedTypeSets.description: GPAF field batch (little-endian): "GPAF", u16 version 1, u16 field count, then each field name (u8 length + bytes), u32 record count, then each record's values in header order. Fields: ENTITY_ID (string: u32 length + bytes, kept exactly) and EPOCH (Unix seconds, UTC), MEAN_MOTION, ECCENTRICITY, INCLINATION, RA_OF_ASC_NODE, ARG_OF_PERICENTER, MEAN_ANOMALY, BSTAR (IEEE-754 binary64). Every field exactly once, in any order; unknown fields are refused.

wildcardJustification.detail: Transient input frame from the GP archive importer to this encoder: the parsed field values of one batch, named by the SDS field names of the record being built and carried as their exact bytes and IEEE-754 bits. It is never stored or published; only the $MPE/$CAT records this method returns are persisted, and those are typed on the output port.

inputPorts.description: One field batch frame holding the records to build.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $MPE stream: concatenated [u32le length][$MPE buffer] frames, each padded to 8 bytes with zeros (zero-length prefixes are padding). Archive encoding v1: every field written, defaults included, MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY = SGP4.

outputPorts.description: The built records, one per input element, in input order.

methods.description: Builds one $MPE per input element set in archive encoding v1. A malformed batch is refused whole.

acceptedTypeSets.description: GPAF field batch (little-endian): "GPAF", u16 version 1, u16 field count, then each field name (u8 length + bytes), u32 record count, then each record's values in header order. Fields: OBJECT_ID and OBJECT_NAME (string: u32 length + bytes, kept exactly) and NORAD_CAT_ID (u32). Every field exactly once, in any order; unknown fields are refused.

wildcardJustification.detail: Transient input frame from the GP archive importer to this encoder: the parsed field values of one batch, named by the SDS field names of the record being built and carried as their exact bytes and IEEE-754 bits. It is never stored or published; only the $MPE/$CAT records this method returns are persisted, and those are typed on the output port.

inputPorts.description: One field batch frame holding the records to build.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $CAT stream: concatenated [u32le length][$CAT buffer] frames, each padded to 8 bytes with zeros (zero-length prefixes are padding). Archive encoding v1: OBJECT_ID, NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_NAME, defaults omitted.

outputPorts.description: The built records, one per input element, in input order.

methods.description: Builds one $CAT per input catalog row in archive encoding v1. A malformed batch is refused whole.
